title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Team goals at home
hook: Do your team's parents know what the team is working toward?
intro: The team goal is better throwing.
Parents still ask how many hits their kid got.
statement: Parents cheer for what they know matters.
q1: Do you share the team goals with parents —
q2: or keep goals within the team?
q3: What would parents ask about if they knew?
t1: Both can work. But kids hear one message
t2: when parents know what the team is working on.
cta: Coaches — do you share team goals?
ctaLines: A short note. At the first meeting. Team only.
Share or keep in the team?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do your team's parents know what the team is working toward?
The team goal is better throwing. Parents still ask how many hits their kid got.
Parents cheer for what they know matters.
Share team goals or keep them in the team. There is no single right way.
Do you share team goals? Share your habit in the comments.
